Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Vast
Hirelings: 4
Order: Empower

A stage, a backstage area for props and sets, and seating for a small audience.

Empower: Theatrical Event. The hirelings start work on a play or concert: 14 days of rehearsals, then at least 7 days of performances, which can continue until a new production begins. You or another character can contribute in the following ways.

  • Composer/Writer: compose the music or write the script of a production that hasn't started rehearsals, over 14 days.
  • Conductor/Director: a character who stays in the Bastion for the whole production can conduct or direct it.
  • Performer: a character who stays in the Bastion for the whole rehearsal period can star in performances; a hireling can serve as understudy.

At the end of the rehearsals, each contributor can make a DC 15 Charisma (Performance) check. If more checks succeed than fail, you and each contributor gain a Theater die, a d6 (d8 at level 13, d10 at level 17). After the rehearsals, a character can expend their Theater die to roll it and add the number to one D20 Test, immediately after rolling the d20. A character who gains a new Theater die before using the first one loses the first.
